output.reason: The linked PR [ev-867e1b5ae410] fills in what the one-line note [ev-4f1d0d4d568e] leaves out. When Crossplane ran with the `--debug` flag, controller-runtime logs were never printed, because `ctrl.SetLogger` was called twice. For example, a reconciler panic's stack trace was never logged. The fix, in cmd/crossplane/main.go [ev-5480f90e702f], sets the discard logger only when debug is false. That gives each open aspect: the subject is controller-runtime logging in the crossplane binary under `--debug`, the change is a behavior change (those logs were dropped and are now emitted), and exposure is installations running with `--debug`. The consequence is informational: those installations now see the controller-runtime logs they were missing, with no breakage stated.
